comparison.objective: Commission a damper versus lock a bicycle wheel to a stand with a U-lock.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires tool insertion, fine collar adjustment, and torque-limited relocking; record threads a rigid shackle through spokes and around a post, then aligns both legs simultaneously into a crossbar.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two energy-qualified safe stops; record requires the wheel and stand captured, both shackle legs seated and locked, without spoke damage or an insecure arrangement.
comparison.reason: Multi-object routing and simultaneous two-leg insertion are materially different from dynamic tuning. Candidate rebound, overload, and drift thresholds remain undeclared.
